text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Invited by Kitasan Black, I decided to 
stop by a limited-time event at the 
amusement park.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"It's a really huge maze, so they said 
it's okay to call out directions from the 
outside!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And I heard yesterday that if you manage 
to escape, you get a "Well Done Medal"—
Nwooooo!! BAKUSHIーーーN!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? Could that voice just now be...?

What in the world?! Another dead end?! 
Grrr, what a formidable labyrinth this is!

However, I shall not be discouraged! 
Because I, Sakura Bakushin O, am the Class 
Representative! And a role model for all!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I knew it! Bakushin O-san, you're in this 
maze too!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, Bakushin O-san was the one who 
told me that story about the medals, too! 
She's super fired up, isn't she!"

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Attendant
text_block_list.text:
It's great that she's so fired up, but I'm 
starting to get genuinely worried.

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Attendant
text_block_list.text:
"Do you two know each other, by any 
chance? She's been lost here since 
morning."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Th-That's terrible! We have to show them 
where the exit is right away!"

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Attendant
text_block_list.text:
Well, no matter how much I called out to 
her, she was so absorbed in running that 
she couldn't hear me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "Leave that to me! Here I gooo~!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
—Whoaaaaa!!!! Who is it that calls upon 
this Class Rep?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"It's me! Kitasan Black! I'll guide you 
from here, so please follow my 
instructions~!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! As expected of me! I safely 
obtained the "Well Done Medal"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And our Apprentice Assistant Class Rep, 
Kita-san! Nice save back there! You get a 
big gold star!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
True to the name, it's an important role 
assisting this class representative... 
well, an apprentice for it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, actually, Bakushin O-san and I go 
out together quite a lot, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! So it's this way! Thank you very 
much! BAKUSHIIIIIN!!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Not that way— Wait, she can't even 
hear me anymore!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san! Not that way, please 
stooop!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hm! Did I just hear Kita-san calling for 
me?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-saaan! Your handkerchief! This 
girl picked it up for you~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! We've come so far before I even 
noticed! All thanks to my marvelous 
Bakushin speed!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, yeah. For some reason, my voice 
really seems to reach Bakushin O-san quite 
well.”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
" 'You're perfect as an assistant!' is 
what they told me when appointing me!"
choice_data_list: Does it sound like someone you know?

Maybe it's thanks to my enka vocal 
training

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Now that you mention it, it feels 
somewhat nostalgic...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I kind of feel like I might have heard 
that somewhere before... but putting that 
aside!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Being with you lets me act even more like 
a class rep, Kita-san! I look forward to 
your continued support as my assistant!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that I've shown you how it's 
done, it's you two's turn!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Allow this Class Rep to guide you 
personally! Please don't hesitate to ask!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, under Sakura Bakushin O's 
occasionally misguided directions, Kitasan 
Black and I had a blast in the giant 
maze."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed! The enka soul pouring from 
Kita-san's voice feels deeply resonant 
with my own Bakushin heart!"
choice_data_list:
What do you mean by 'resonate'... for 
example?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: In other words, it's like this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: BAKUSHIIIIIIIN--!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a powerful vocal vibrato! Then 
I'll—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: BAKUSHIIIIIIIN--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could this really be called 'resonating 
with each other'? Regardless, Kitasan 
Black and Sakura Bakushin O looked like 
they were having a blast.
